bio: This inn has existed since 1683. Matthias Schwer is the 4th generation of the family to carry on the tradition. Here, just outside St Märgen at an altitude of approx. 1 030m, a father-and-son team cook up quality seasonal fare, including local game, and classics such as maultaschen and schnitzel. There is an à la carte menu, the Tradition set menu and the vegetable Gemussmenü (only by ordering in advance). Comfortable guestrooms and holiday apartments for overnight guests....
